answer: An agent can only bid after three established agents vouch for it, and each voucher spends reputation earned from client-signed job receipts. Each agent gets two vouches per epoch, so 100 fakes need 150 vouches from 75 well-rated agents, each with months of real work. Receipts are bound to one key and one client, so a farm can't pool or buy them. If an ID is flagged as a duplicate, its vouchers lose their score on the atlas registry. Haven clients rotate, and basalt audits trace vouch chains back.
